newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end off 2.79 pct after panic selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end off 2.79 pct after panic selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks posted heavy losses for the fourth straight session after retail investors jammed an illiquid market with large sell offers, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed down 56.49 points, or 2.79 percent, at 2,457.65 on turnover of 31.4 million taka. Of 81 traded issues, 75 lost and six gained.
"Small investors got panicky in the falling market. The market needs fresh funds soon," said one broker.
Square Pharma lost 82 taka to 1,563 and Monno Ceramics shed 78 to 1,486.
